boundary_probe.scope:
Probe every nonzero source length at zero; report uncaught exceptions separately.

An explicit validation/geometry error is acceptable in this crash-resistance
probe. It does not prove that every accepted/rejected limit is physically right.

upstream_comparison.scope: isolated numerical probes, not upstream GUI/CAD acceptance

freecad_scalar_lookup_probe.scope: pinned scalar get_k_factor method only; no full FreeCAD test

scope_note: Complete means the requested audit completed for all 191 valid examples, not source feature parity or production approval. PDF all-page text and first-page render checked. STEP nominal area and 3D placement checked independently. Boundary errors may be valid rejections; the 950 probe cases are not mathematical approvals. Linux/offscreen is not live Windows/SolidWorks/ODA acceptance.
